say:1:1320202401:1.text: I'm no ordinary blacksmith, you know? I'm a master blacksmith!
say:1:1320202401:1.source_cn: 什么？铁匠？不不不，铁匠是铁匠，铁匠大师是铁匠大师！
say:1:1320202401:1.male: I'm no ordinary blacksmith, you know? I'm a master blacksmith!
say:1:1320202401:1.female: I'm no ordinary blacksmith, you know? I'm a master blacksmith!

say:2:1320202402:1.text: What makes a master? Only the most meticulous person with the finest skills and most exquisite craftsmanship deserves the title!
say:2:1320202402:1.source_cn: 什么叫做大师？最精湛的技巧、最严谨的态度、最精美的造型...
say:2:1320202402:1.male: What makes a master? Only the most meticulous person with the finest skills and most exquisite craftsmanship deserves the title!
say:2:1320202402:1.female: What makes a master? Only the most meticulous person with the finest skills and most exquisite craftsmanship deserves the title!

say:3:1320202403:1.text: All my creations, whether weapons or armor, are built to endure the harshest of tests.
say:3:1320202403:1.source_cn: 我锻造的装备，无论是武器还是防具，都经得起最严苛的测试。
say:3:1320202403:1.male: All my creations, whether weapons or armor, are built to endure the harshest of tests.
say:3:1320202403:1.female: All my creations, whether weapons or armor, are built to endure the harshest of tests.

say:4:1320202404:1.text: Just grab whatever you like! I swear on my beard and hammer, they're the best!

say:4:1320202404:1.female: Just grab whatever you like! I swear on my beard and hammer, they're the best!
